name: tv2-subtitle-studio
description: Chrome extension that loads every TV 2 Play subtitle into a scrolling, time-synced overlay you can click to seek and translate with Google Translate. Great for learning Norwegian.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run icons && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run clean:all && npm run build && node scripts/pack-zip.mjs && node scripts/pack-crx.mjs
